title: How to manage paralegal billable hours on Mac: simple steps for better accuracy

description: Struggling with paralegal billable hours? Learn why manual tracking fails and how to use your Mac to capture more time without the burnout.
intro: Paralegal billable hours often slip through the cracks because manual entry feels like a chore that distracts from actual legal work. You can recover lost revenue and reduce your daily stress by shifting from memory-based logging to automated, background tracking on your Mac.

blocks.text: Why tracking paralegal billable hours is difficult

Legal work is fragmented by nature. You jump from a draft in Word to an email in Outlook, then to a research portal in Chrome. This constant context switching makes it hard to keep a running mental clock. When you rely on your memory to log time at the end of the day, you lose detail. Research shows that recall accuracy drops significantly after just 24 hours. You end up guessing, which creates risks for your firm and frustration for you.
The hidden cost of manual entry

Most paralegals treat time tracking as an afterthought. You finish a task, move to the next, and promise to log the time later. That later never comes or becomes a frantic attempt to reconstruct the day. Small tasks, like a 6-minute email or a quick phone call, are often ignored because they seem too minor to log. These small increments add up to thousands of dollars in lost revenue annually. Manual entry also increases the risk of errors in billing codes. These mistakes can trigger ethical reviews or malpractice concerns if they become a pattern.
How to fix your tracking workflow

items: Use automated background trackers like Timing or Memtime to capture your active window time.
Set up time-blocking in your calendar to dedicate 10 minutes at the end of every 4-hour block for entry.
Always verify your entries against your sent email folder and your recent file history in Word or Excel.
Keep a simple physical notepad for quick notes if you are away from your Mac, then transcribe them immediately.

faq.question: Does Lazur automatically log my billable hours?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or operate other apps for you. It helps you find features, guides you through workflows, and drafts text, but you remain in control of the final time entry.

faq.question: Can I use automated trackers on my work Mac?
faq.answer: Most automated trackers like Timing or Memtime are standard, but check with your IT department to ensure they comply with your firm's security and privacy policies.

faq.question: How do I stop losing time on small tasks?
faq.answer: Use a timer that runs in the background. If you keep a log of your active windows, you can look back at the end of the day and see exactly how much time you spent in each application.

fixes.title: Passive Tracking
